description: This file defines the TableStyle class within the PhpSpreadsheet library, representing styling options for tables in spreadsheets. It includes constants for predefined style names, properties for configuring style features, and getter/setter methods for manipulating these properties.

classes.name: TableStyle
classes.description: Represents styling options for tables in spreadsheets, including style themes and visual stripe configurations.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new TableStyle with an optional theme parameter.

methods.name: getTheme
methods.description: Retrieves the current theme style name.

methods.name: getShowFirstColumn
methods.description: Returns whether the first column is shown with special styling.

methods.name: setShowFirstColumn
methods.description: Enables or disables special styling for the first column.

methods.name: getShowLastColumn
methods.description: Returns whether the last column is shown with special styling.

methods.name: setShowLastColumn
methods.description: Enables or disables special styling for the last column.

methods.name: getShowRowStripes
methods.description: Checks if row stripes are enabled.

methods.name: getShowColumnStripes
methods.description: Checks if column stripes are enabled.

methods.name: getTable
methods.description: Retrieves the Table object associated with this style.

methods.name: setTable
methods.description: Associates a Table object with this style.
